plan.archetype: Flexible poison scaling with efficient attacks and defensive support
plan.bossPrep: Add efficient damage to reach the stun threshold promptly, sustained poison afterward, and reliable block plus Weak. Upgrade key damage and scaling cards.
plan.summary: Secure early attack damage and AoE before adding poison scaling. Maintain reliable defense, remove Strikes after replacing their damage, and take elites only with adequate combat strength.

plan.archetype: Efficient attacks into poison scaling with reliable defense
plan.bossPrep: Improve immediate damage to reach the stun threshold quickly, then sustain poison. Secure efficient block and Weak; heal at the next fire.
plan.summary: The current deck needs substantial damage improvement. Buy efficient combat cards and potions, heal immediately, limit elite exposure, and upgrade key attacks when healthy. Add poison scaling without neglecting defense.

plan.archetype: Strength-supported attacks transitioning into poison scaling and efficient defense
plan.bossPrep: Heal at the final campfire. Use temporary Strength, Vulnerable, and the shiv potion to reach the stun threshold; establish poison and maintain Weak.
plan.summary: Immediate survival comes first: buy sustained attack damage and heal before the boss. Accelerate the stun threshold, then finish with poison. Later add stronger poison application, defensive scaling, and draw; remove redundant Strikes.

plan.archetype: Strength-scaled attacks with poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Build Strength and poison, maintain Weak, and preserve essential block when exhausting. Save Expose for post-kill block; stock defensive potions.
plan.summary: Mittens supplies scaling while thinning weak cards. Add poison, draw, and dexterity; preserve sufficient defense. Avoid early elites, use three campfires, and upgrade core cards when healthy.

plan.archetype: Strength-scaled shivs and poison with durable defense
plan.bossPrep: Recover HP, strengthen block and Weak coverage, and preserve defensive cards from Mittens. Use poison against post-kill block; face Rocket during its heavy attacks.
plan.summary: Prioritize reaching campfires alive on the lowest-risk route. Heal urgently, avoid elites, and improve defensive consistency so Mittens and poison have time to scale. Replace Strikes rather than sacrificing essential block.

plan.archetype: Strength-scaled shivs and multihit AoE with poison-backed defense
plan.bossPrep: Use Strength Potion early; deploy Cunning Potion with Strength and Afterimage. Preserve defensive cards from Mittens, face Rocket during lasers, and use Expose against crab armor.
plan.summary: Damage gap is uncalibrated. Preserve defense while Mittens scales; exploit Strength with shivs and multihit AoE. Poison bypasses crab armor. After surviving the boss, prioritize defensive scaling, remove Strikes, and upgrade key cards when healthy.
